Drift compares two halves of normal audio, so about 50 % means no drift. The training range is the smallest to largest normalised log-mel value in the training clips, which is what the int8 input is calibrated on. The other take is the 6 normal clips of session pilot recorded at gain 4: the same fan, taken off its mount and put back before the training take. They are normal, so about 50 % is expected; a high value means the models hear the take, not only the fault.
